text:
The multi-sensory experience described is a forest installation that immerses visitors in the Amazon rainforest. It utilizes high-definition screens to provide visual stimulation of lush greenery, speakers to emit the auditory experience of rainforest sounds, and mist machines to release the olfactory scent of wet earth and leaves. Additionally, the tactile sense is engaged through a ground surface made of soft, uneven materials that mimic the texture of the forest floor.

The name of the river that runs through London is the River Thames.
